 Telangana Narlagiri Yadagiri 5 Nov 2026 8:24 PM IST 5 Nov 2026 8:24 PM IST The Congress has announced Ram Reddy Sarvottam Reddy as its candidate: Reports
 x Congress MLC candidate Ram Reddy Sarvottam Reddy— DC Image As Preferred
Source WARANGAL: Major political parties have stepped up voter registration and campaign preparations for the Khammam-Warangal-Nalgonda Graduates’ MLC election.
 The Congress has announced Ram Reddy Sarvottam Reddy as its candidate, while the BRS is expected to field Enugula Rakesh Reddy. The BJP is yet to finalise its nominee.
 Congress candidate Sarvottam Reddy is meeting party leaders and workers across the Khammam, Warangal, and Nalgonda districts and campaigning for the election. The BRS has not officially announced its candidate, but sources revealed it is planning to field Rakesh Reddy.
 In BJP, social equations, past representation to districts, and possibility of an alliance with Jana Sena are influencing the selection process. It is said party state spokesperson Dr. Vannala Venkataramana is among the frontrunners, while PRTU leader Sunkari Bhiksham Goud too is reportedly in the race. In addition, the name of Tota Ravikumar from Nalgonda district is figuring in discussions.
 Jana Sena has announced Dr Gadala Srinivasa Rao as its candidate, raising questions over whether the BJP will support him or field its own nominee. BJP had once been a strong political force in the erstwhile Warangal district.
 The deadline for submitting Form-18 applications is November 6. The draft electoral roll will be published on November 25, while the final voters’ list is scheduled for December 30. The enrolment drive is significant because graduates, who voted in the previous election, will have to register afresh.
 The term of sitting MLC Chintapandu 'Teenmaar Mallanna' Naveen Kumar is ending in March 2027. With Congress and BRS ready with their preparations, the delay by BJP could put it at a disadvantage.
